name: Datetime testing
description: Provides an API to help develop automated tests that involve dates and times.
project_description: The Datetime Testing module provides an API that helps develop automated tests of Drupal functionality that depends on dates and times. It decorates Drupal's datetime.time service so the reported current time can be set, frozen, unfrozen, or reset, and persists those manipulations across requests via the keyvalue store so they survive the multiple HTTP requests of a functional test. It also ships a TestDateTime drop-in replacement for DrupalDateTime that interprets strtotime()-style strings relative to the manipulated time rather than the real system clock, a Behat context with steps like 'Given the time is 12pm', and Drush commands to set/get/freeze/unfreeze/reset the time from the CLI. It is a developer-only tool that should not be enabled in production; the module's hook_requirements() surfaces a warning to that effect and the project has no security-advisory coverage.
